scope: Matched shared-Mie-kernel numerical component reference, not total-atmosphere accuracy or original LUT provenance

definition.interpolation: linear n and log-linear k versus vacuum wavelength
definition.effective_radius_um: original selected Gamma8 values and21.5 endpoint
definition.spectral_average: thin: average ext,sca,abs,sca*g then form g; not mean(g)

tasks.primary: LW6 for all six original radii; SW6/8 for four day radii:14 combinations
tasks.weak_absorption: only SW11@22.12519645690918 and SW12@21.5; qualify or exclude them separately
tasks.axes: radius-half at fixed fine spectral grid; spectral-half at fixed fine radial grid; no diagonal-only convergence claim

method.radius_quadrature: Gauss-Legendre diameter nodes with number-Gamma pdf, actual volume/mass normalization; not previous uniform-Simpson area measure
method.spectral_quadrature: composite trapezoid, uniform wavenumber grid plus every refractive-index knot in band
method.external_density_and_RI_defaults: bypassed with explicit matching caller arguments

predeclared_numerical_screens.estimate_type: max axis refinement changes and method discrepancies; empirical estimates, not certified true-error bounds
predeclared_numerical_screens.failure_rule: retain failures and exclude their radius/band from qualified reference scope; never tune screens to match LUT

propagation.state: same old night/day input.dat, unchanged diagnostic executable
propagation.modified: only qualified computed coefficient entries, all other moments byte-preserved
propagation.uncertainty: direct signed same-target axis differences; no inference from different-location maxima
